question: Does the /txd2 signal maintain a voltage of 0V during the entire simulation?

response.reasoning: The /TXD2 net is connected to R1 (10k pull-up to +3V3) and R2 (5.1k to Q2 base), forming a voltage divider/pull-up circuit, so it will not be at 0V; it will be pulled toward +3V3 through R1 when Q2 is not actively pulling it down, meaning it won't maintain 0V throughout the simulation.
